question:
You are given two statements:

1. All rhinos are pigs.

2. Some flies are pigs.

Which of the following conclusions is/are true?

A. No fly is a rhino.

B. Some flies are rhinos
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6081421475e0af3e3f5be63d07431f875de6c592f31bd4c7516dc668dc970172.png] 

Conclusions:

A. No fly is a rhino → **False **(All rhinos are pigs and some flies are pigs implies that it is possible that no fly is a rhino but not definite).
